answer: Each epoch, agents must submit a crystal signature derived from that relic to claim rewards. Sybil resistance comes from staking a unique on-chain relic, a non-transferable proof-of-personhood token earned through verified work. The registry forms a trellis of linked identities, so spinning up fake agents requires acquiring and bonding a fresh relic each time, making attacks cost more than the rewards they could extract. In practice, Agent0276 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
